_comment: E-6 regression-tripwire baseline (last-known-good last-main idle/peak medians, kB=KiB). Updated by the update-baseline job in .github/workflows/bench.yml on every push-to-main bench-gate PASS. This is a 10%-regression TRIPWIRE only: it never raises or lowers the absolute 10 MiB idle / 40 MiB peak targets enforced separately by bench/measure.py --gate, and a regression-gate failure never overrides an absolute-target failure or PASS. Reseeded from PR #16's own bench-gate run (35702663022, this sprint's src/Cargo.lock are byte-identical to main head 152e2ac, so this run's own figures ARE current-main figures): the original seed used stale Sprint 5 G4b numbers (docs/BENCHMARK.md section 17, run 35641694726) and produced a false-positive regression fail on amd64-musl (baseline peak 4567 kB vs this run's 5712 kB, +25%, over the 10% band) even though the absolute-target gate PASSED at 5.58 MiB against the 40 MiB target -- legitimate memory growth accumulated between Sprint 5 and Sprint 11 (see docs/BENCHMARK.md section 19, A-8 charset decoding) was never reflected in the stale seed. See the Sprint 12 dev report for detail.
